title: What is a directory?
question: A directory is names, each pointing to a file. What happens when one is made, and when one is listed? (In memory: ramfs.)

stops.note: A new directory: an inode like a file's, and a name for it in /.
Listing: an in-memory directory's names are the dentry cache itself; walk its children...
...each copied out to the program: its name, its inode, its type.
